text: bring the api key store into this app natively so its all in house please
resolution: Brought the API key store fully in-house (req_1118). The nano-gpt key now lives in hmsc-int's OWN localstore (nsGet/nsSet, 'hmsc' namespace, key nano-gpt-api-key; getNanoKey/setNanoKey in textureGen.ts), entered once in a new 'api key' field in the AI Fill dialog and remembered across sessions — no longer read from the image-gen app's Postgres store. To remove the Postgres dependency cleanly, the pure network client was split out into a DB-free cart/image-gen/client.ts (buildPayload + generateToBase64 with the API key passed IN as a param); image-gen's generate.ts keeps generateBatch, looking its key up in Postgres and passing it through (the image-gen app is unchanged). hmsc-int now imports client.ts only, so the Studio bundle has ZERO __pg_ references (was 4) and 4 __localstore refs — meaning NO dev-host rebuild is needed anymore (the prior caveat is gone). Verified: editMesh 48/48, modelStream 8/8, textureize 9/9; client + generate + textureGen + Studio + sources + the image-gen Generate/Queue pages all bundle clean. PLAYBOOK 5.6b + build log + project_studio_mesh_editor memory updated to drop the rebuild caveat. Fully hot-reloadable.
